target_binary.note: GOG 1.03 PE, sha256 9c10e0450a6eeca417e036e3cde7474fed1f0a92aab018446d156944dea91435; VAs at image base 0x400000.

purpose: kp.camera Stage 1 (read-only snapshot, K1 GOG only): client camera pointer chain, chase-behaviour (CSWCameraOnAStick) fields, the pending camera-style global and the vtables the runtime compares. The generator reads every <alias>_*_bindings.json.

derivations.method: in-memory reads of the raw image with python3 and i686-w64-mingw32-objdump (replay commands in its section 7)
pefile + capstone linear sweep, Part A written before reading the plan; verdict CONFIRMS, no disagreements

reference_image.note: file offset == RVA for .text/.rdata/.data; tools/camera_profile_consistency_test.py re-reads every guard from it

accept_rule: accept requires two independent derivations of the same immediate from the raw image (the plan and the re-derivation) plus a second code site or store that uses the same offset (METHOD.md section 1). Meaning-unverified offsets carry the word unverified in their name and a limits note; their offset and extent are what is accepted.
field_shape: kind=field rows carry owner, offset and size; addr is the owning global or 0 behind a pointer chain. kind=reference rows are vtable addresses compared as pointers.
open_items: live readback: no snapshot has been taken in a running game
